name: gmr-cmu137-asflen
command:
.venv/bin/python -u tools_amc_csv_f1.py --asf downloads/cmu137/137.asf --amc downloads/cmu137/137_24.amc --output_file whole_body_tracking/motions/csv/cmu137_24_f1.csv > /tmp/gmr_v8.log 2>&1; grep -E "ground|scale|travel|Saved" /tmp/gmr_v8.log; .venv/bin/python tools_check_motion_f1.py --csv whole_body_tracking/motions/csv/cmu137_24_f1.csv --fps 30 --json_out whole_body_tracking/motions/quality_cmu137_24_f1_csv.json > /tmp/gate_v8.log 2>&1; python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('whole_body_tracking/motions/quality_cmu137_24_f1_csv.json'))
g=d['ground']; s=d['self_penetration']
print(f\"ground {g['min_foot_z_m']:.4f} @f{g['frame']} pass={g['pass']} | self {s['min_pair_distance_m']:.4f} pass={s['pass']} | limits={d['joint_limits']['pass']} vel={d['joint_velocities']['pass']} hgt=[{d['root_height']['min_m']:.2f},{d['root_height']['max_m']:.2f}] pass={d['root_height']['pass']} | OVERALL={d['overall_pass']}\")"
